# VictorySync

> VictorySync is a US-managed contact center with Cairo-based agents for appointment setting, cold calling, lead qualification, and inbound customer support.

## About

VictorySync provides inbound customer support, outbound appointment setting and cold calling, and AI-powered automation services. All agent teams are English-proficient and operate in US business hours.

## Primary Sections

- [Home](https://www.victorysync.com/): Overview of services, outcomes, and customer stories.
- [Services](https://www.victorysync.com/services): Full catalog of contact center offerings.
- [Inbound Support](https://www.victorysync.com/inbound-support): Live agent inbound customer service programs.
- [Appointment Setting](https://www.victorysync.com/appointment-setting): Outbound scheduling and pipeline-building services.
- [Cold Calling](https://www.victorysync.com/cold-calling): Outbound prospecting and lead generation.
- [AI Automation](https://www.victorysync.com/ai-automation): Chatbot, workflow, and AI-assisted CX tools.
- [Platform](https://www.victorysync.com/platform): The VictorySync technology platform and dashboard.
- [Pricing](https://www.victorysync.com/pricing): Service package pricing and quote requests.
- [Book a Call](https://www.victorysync.com/book-call): Schedule a discovery call with the VictorySync team.
- [About](https://www.victorysync.com/about): Company overview.
- [About Us](https://www.victorysync.com/about-us): Company background, mission, and leadership.
